summary.text: Myriad Star Fireflies is Dong Fang Chang Fan's strongest wisdom path immortal killer move. Starlight fireflies laced with star thoughts turn enemies' thinking into more ammunition, and the move favors group fights over single duels.

claims.text: At Tai Qiu, the Gu Immortal presenting as Dong Fang Yu Liang points skyward and names Myriad Star Fireflies word by word. Darkness falls, firefly-like starlight fills the field, and demonic path Gu Immortals fall into the swarm. One speck is weak, but tens of thousands to tens of millions of spots press from all sides; destroyed light still drives star thoughts into minds to disrupt thought, dull wits, or replace cognition until the victim becomes a puppet. Unfettered Scholar had lost to this move before and later dug into Dong Fang Chang Fan’s methods after that defeat. Activating it involves tens of thousands of Gu worms. Dong Fang Chang Fan created it while developing Dong Fang tribe with few Gu Immortal helpers.

Old Lord Can Yang is shocked by the move’s might and stays hidden while healing, hoping to use the field if Fang Yuan enters the fight. When Dong Fang Chang Fan suffers internal backlash, the orderly myriad star fireflies that had been attacking and defending in turn fly around chaotically and pressure on the demonic path side falls.

Seeing demonic path Gu Immortals looting Jade Pool, Dong Fang Chang Fan spends heavily and fires his trump card killer move Myriad Star Fireflies, filling the sky with starlight like snow. With Miniscule Mountain in hand he manipulates the fireflies again as a huge blue wave while his battle strength climbs as the move strengthens.

Studying that inheritance, Fang Yuan judges the line mainly favors deductions rather than battle, yet Dong Fang Chang Fan conceived myriad star fireflies to turn that deduction strength into offense, making it the inheritance’s strongest offensive killer move. Each starlight firefly is encased in a star thought, and each use consumes at least sixteen wisdom path dao marks.
There is no upper limit on that consumption: the wider the range or the higher the power, the more dao marks a single use burns.

Dao marks enter space and form a hard-to-destroy battlefield; Gu Immortals in range convert thoughts into star thoughts that fuel the attack, so the move grows over time by turning enemy strength against them. The cost is why Dong Fang Chang Fan usually schemed and used the move only when he had no choice. The killer move needs a core of three wisdom path Immortal Gu; Fang Yuan holds none after Dong Fang Chang Fan self-detonates his Immortal Gu. Fang Yuan ranks it on par with his then Myriad Self, while noting Myriad Self still has more room to improve and that without wisdom path dao marks he may never use myriad star fireflies.

Recalling Dong Fang Chang Fan’s move alongside Ye Lui Qun Xing’s star-fragment killer move, Fang Yuan decides to imitate myriad star fireflies as a new immortal killer move built around his newly gained vajra thought Immortal Gu. His wisdom path grandmaster intuition tells him the deduction will not be difficult, and the attempt goes smoothly, reaching half completion after an hour and full completion after a day and night of uninterrupted deduction as a divination tortoise. He leaves the move unnamed, planning instead to use divination tortoise transformation to raise its strength beyond what a rank six core alone provides.
